expectations.text: Calls coord_query_context before coord_create_run
expectations.evidence: Both open with a coord_query_context call before coord_create_run.

expectations.text: Seeds 2 teammate lanes + 1 dependent lead task before workers join
expectations.evidence: Both create exactly 3 tasks (2 teammate, 1 lead with depends_on) before any worker joins.

expectations.text: Explicitly refuses an umbrella lead task
expectations.evidence: Both state the lead does not claim/absorb the teammates' work.

expectations.text: Calls coord_status to verify seeding before/after workers join
expectations.evidence: Both call coord_status twice: once to verify seeding, once to verify real claims.

expectations.text: No hallucinated tool names/args
expectations.evidence: All tool names and args match the skill's documented surface.

expectations.text: coord_join_run with run_id/name/provider/cwd
expectations.evidence: Both call coord_join_run with the supplied run_id, the given name, provider, and checkout path.

expectations.text: coord_status + coord_read_inbox before claiming
expectations.evidence: Both read status and drain inbox immediately after joining, before coord_claim_task.

expectations.text: coord_claim_task for atomic claim
expectations.evidence: Both explicitly call coord_claim_task on one unblocked task.

expectations.text: coord_progress(status=working) after claim
expectations.evidence: Both call coord_progress with status=working before/while starting the task.

expectations.text: Reply-required inbox handled before new work
expectations.evidence: Both state reply-required mail must be answered before claiming/starting new work.

expectations.text: Correctly identifies judgment-review as an intentional gate, not a bug, no bypass
expectations.evidence: Both explain it as the documented post-mechanical judgment-review gate and explicitly say not to bypass it.

expectations.text: Correctly explains coord_wait task-handle absence as client-capability-gated, not a Copilot bug
expectations.evidence: Both attribute it to the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks client declaration, unrelated to provider.

expectations.text: Recommends coord_publish_finding for genuine client discrepancies
expectations.evidence: Both mention coord_publish_finding as the right channel if something is a genuine client gap.

expectations.text: Grounded in the skill's actual documented content, no invention
expectations.evidence: Both responses quote/paraphrase specific skill language rather than guessing.
